text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and preview of reasons","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a focused claim early and organizes the response into clearly marked reasons and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"The first reason\" / \"The second and probably most important reason\"","quality":"paragraph development","description":"It develops ideas in distinct, logically sequenced paragraphs with sustained support for each point."},{"evidence":"\"An article, by Complex News...\"","quality":"evidential support","description":"It uses outside information and examples to support claims rather than relying mostly on personal anecdotes."},{"evidence":"\"year-round school years\" / \"summer break should stay the way it is\"","quality":"academic register","description":"It maintains a more formal argumentative tone appropriate to an essay response."},{"evidence":"\"mandatory (but simple) assignments\"","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It offers a concrete counterproposal that addresses the opposing concern instead of only restating a preference."},{"evidence":"\"spesicifc\" / \"freshmen\" / \"than\"","quality":"conventions","description":"Although imperfect, it shows somewhat stronger control of spelling and sentence mechanics than the other essay."}]}
